# FAD驱动数据库优化验证结果

<!-- GUIDED-TEN-MILLION-START -->
## DAComp-006：千万行，SQL分析指导，两对实验

**数据库前台累计处理时间，两次平均：普通 182.267 秒 → 使用FAD 127.623 秒，减少 29.98%。**

独立新Agent在同一份10,000,000行数据上，根据每次查询结果继续分析，共执行32条业务数据查询，最后用Q33的 `SELECT 1` 提交“无后续访问”标记。合计33次SQL调用全部成功，均保留在计时中。Agent已提交报告。

本次在提示中增加分析步骤要求，把波动统计、贡献分解等计算交给SQL；没有提供旧SQL/FAD、旧数值或结论，也没有设定查询轮数目标。实际查询如何分布，以及分析报告的局限，见下文。

### 两对结果

| 配对 | 普通执行，秒 | 使用FAD，秒 | 节省，秒 | 节省比例 | 加上清理后的节省，秒 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 182.394 | 127.965 | +54.429 | +29.84% | +54.387 |
| 2 | 182.140 | 127.282 | +54.859 | +30.12% | +54.817 |

使用FAD更快：2/2对。全部132次回放与来源结果核对、66次两组直接比较通过。

只累计数据库工具开始处理SQL至结果返回的前台时间，包含解析、快照、匹配/改写、计划检查、执行、结果归档、日志和FAD提交。普通组只执行SQL。后台准备不串行相加，后台与查询同时运行造成的争用已体现在查询实测时间中；末尾清理单列。

来源间隔合计258.701秒，记录后复用；只实际运行查询和后台工作，剩余空闲跳过。后台超过间隔时下一条查询仍按时执行。时间提取依据：serial_mcp_service；客户端如有并发提交，以原串行MCP服务边界记录间隔，不把排队当作优化空闲窗口。

### 实际利用了多少FAD

| 配对 | 后台处理了多少轮FAD | 其中格式通过 | 其中包含未来访问预测 | 通过的候选访问包数 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 33/33 | 31 | 30 | 34 |
| 2 | 33/33 | 31 | 30 | 34 |

一个候选访问包可以同时描述表、列、过滤、分组和聚合；上表按完整访问包计数。Q26、Q27的FAD各把两个过滤条件直接并列填写，未按Schema写出明确的AND/OR关系，因此未被接收。原始输入和拒绝原因均保留，未根据新轨迹修改接收规则。Q33明确表示没有后续访问，格式通过但没有预测。

直接使用提前准备对象的SQL共9/32条业务查询：[Q9](#guided-q9)、[Q10](#guided-q10)、[Q11](#guided-q11)、[Q12](#guided-q12)、[Q14](#guided-q14)、[Q18](#guided-q18)、[Q19](#guided-q19)、[Q20](#guided-q20)、[Q30](#guided-q30)。这是实际优化复用数量，不等于FAD每个字段的预测命中率。

共准备7个对象，其中3个被后续查询使用。主要收益来自产品×月份、目的地×月份的重复聚合：后续SQL读取已准备的汇总数据，继续执行原有的波动统计、贡献分解和排名计算。

### 前台和后台各花了多少时间

| 项目（两次平均，秒） | 普通执行 | 使用FAD |
|---|---:|---:|
| SQL执行及结果归档 | 182.259 | 127.438 |
| 前台匹配及改写 | 0 | 0.145 |
| 前台计划检查及索引保护 | 0 | 0.005 |
| 其他前台处理 | 0.008 | 0.035 |
| 后台FAD接收和校验 | 0 | 0.206 |
| 后台构建尝试（含失败） | 0 | 62.180 |
| 成功构建 | 0 | 62.180 |
| 成功构建中与Agent间隔重叠的部分 | 0 | 51.358 |
| 成功构建中与查询重叠的部分 | 0 | 10.822 |
| 末尾清理和关闭 | 0.001 | 0.043 |

后台决策总时长（含构建及统计）平均63.785秒。重叠时间是成功构建时间的子集，不能重复相加。未使用对象和失败尝试均保留成本。

仍有以下明确的未利用机会，下面是对已完成轨迹的事后分析，没有据此回改本批优化动作：

- Q4已经预测了华南按月份汇总，但该过滤和分组组合只出现一次，被预设的“两轮FAD重复出现才构建”规则挡住。因此Q5、Q6、Q7及后来的Q23、Q24、Q31仍扫描原表。门槛减少无效准备，也漏掉了这个可复用方向。
- 已有产品×月份汇总表，但当前实现只做相同分组和过滤的替换，没有把它再按月份汇总，也没有对汇总表增加产品过滤来服务Q21。Q13、Q15等省份分析使用字符串截取表达式，当前也没有对应的表达式分组及跨层改写能力。
- 后续FAD逐步增加聚合指标，后台重新构建了同一分组的更完整版本；表中保留了未使用的旧版本及其成本。索引准入统计发现华南匹配37.18%的数据，超过预设10%门槛，因此本批没有建立索引。

<details><summary>本轮SQL</summary>

```sql
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month,
    SUM(Profit) AS total_profit,
    SUM("Total Logistics Revenue") AS total_revenue,
    SUM("Total Logistics Cost") AS total_cost,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count,
    SUM("Sales Quantity") AS total_quantity,
    SUM("Discount Amount") AS total_discount,
    SUM("Logistics Value-Added Service Revenue") AS total_var
  FROM sheet1 
  WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
)
SELECT * FROM monthly ORDER BY month
```

</details>

#### 新轨迹 Q6

本轮返回后复用的间隔：0.004秒。

| 候选 | 本轮预测 |
|---|---|
| 1 | 补充列：sheet1.Date、sheet1.Profit、sheet1.Total Logistics Revenue、sheet1.Total Logistics Cost、sheet1.Sales Quantity、sheet1.Discount Amount、sheet1.Consigned Product、sheet1.Destination、sheet1.Logistics Unit Price、sheet1.List Price Revenue、sheet1.Logistics Value-Added Service Revenue、sheet1.Freight Cost、sheet1.Warehousing Cost、sheet1.Other Operating Costs；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：sheet1.Date按月、sheet1.Consigned Product；聚合：SUM(sheet1.Profit)、SUM(sheet1.Sales Quantity)、COUNT(*)、SUM(sheet1.Total Logistics Revenue)；连接：无 |

<details><summary>本轮SQL</summary>

```sql
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
),
stats AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(profit) AS mean_p, 
         SQRT(AVG(profit*profit) - AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)) AS sd_pop,
         SQRT((SUM(profit*profit) - SUM(profit)*SUM(profit)/COUNT(*))/(COUNT(*)-1)) AS sd_samp,
         MIN(profit) AS min_p, MAX(profit) AS max_p
  FROM monthly
),
mom AS (
  SELECT month, profit, LAG(profit) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_profit, 
         profit - LAG(profit) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change,
         100.0*(profit - LAG(profit) OVER (ORDER BY month))/LAG(profit) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS pct_change
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT s.n, s.mean_p, s.sd_pop, s.sd_samp, 
       100.0*s.sd_pop/s.mean_p AS cv_pop_pct, 100.0*s.sd_samp/s.mean_p AS cv_samp_pct,
       s.min_p, s.max_p, s.max_p - s.min_p AS range_p, 100.0*(s.max_p-s.min_p)/s.mean_p AS range_pct_of_mean
FROM stats s
```

</details>

| 候选 | 本轮预测 |

| 1 | 补充列：sheet1.Date、sheet1.Profit、sheet1.Total Logistics Revenue、sheet1.Total Logistics Cost、sheet1.Consigned Product、sheet1.Sales Quantity、sheet1.Destination、sheet1.Discount Amount、sheet1.Logistics Unit Price、sheet1.List Price Revenue、sheet1.Logistics Value-Added Service Revenue、sheet1.Freight Cost、sheet1.Warehousing Cost、sheet1.Other Operating Costs；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：sheet1.Date按月、sheet1.Consigned Product；聚合：SUM(sheet1.Profit)、SUM(sheet1.Sales Quantity)、COUNT(*)、SUM(sheet1.Total Logistics Revenue)；连接：无 |

<details><summary>本轮SQL</summary>

```sql
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit, SUM("Total Logistics Revenue") AS rev, SUM("Total Logistics Cost") AS cost, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
)
SELECT month, profit, rev, cost, orders, qty, 
       ROUND(rev/orders, 2) AS rev_per_order, ROUND(rev/qty, 4) AS rev_per_unit, 
       ROUND(qty/orders, 2) AS qty_per_order,
       100.0*(rev-cost)/rev AS margin_pct,
       ROUND(profit - LAG(profit) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) AS profit_chg,
       ROUND(100.0*(profit - LAG(profit) OVER (ORDER BY month))/LAG(profit) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS profit_chg_pct,
       ROUND(rev - LAG(rev) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) AS rev_chg,
       ROUND(orders - LAG(orders) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) AS orders_chg
FROM monthly ORDER BY month
```

</details>

```sql
WITH pm AS (
  SELECT "Consigned Product" AS product, strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY "Consigned Product", strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
)
SELECT product, 
       SUM(profit) AS total_profit,
       AVG(profit) AS mean_m,
       SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)) AS sd_m,
       100.0*(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/AVG(profit)) AS cv_pct,
       MIN(profit) AS min_m, MAX(profit) AS max_m,
       MAX(profit)-MIN(profit) AS range_m
FROM pm GROUP BY product ORDER BY total_profit DESC
```

</details>

<details><summary>本轮SQL</summary>

```sql
WITH pm AS (
  SELECT "Consigned Product" AS product, strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY "Consigned Product", strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
)
SELECT product, month, ROUND(profit, 0) AS profit FROM pm ORDER BY product, month
```

<a id="guided-q11"></a>
#### 新轨迹 Q11

本轮返回后复用的间隔：15.901秒。

| 候选 | 本轮预测 |
|---|---|
| 1 | 补充列：sheet1.Date、sheet1.Profit、sheet1.Destination；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：sheet1.Date按月、sheet1.Destination；聚合：SUM(sheet1.Profit)、SUM(sheet1.Sales Quantity)、COUNT(*)；连接：无 |
| 2 | 补充列：sheet1.Date、sheet1.Profit、sheet1.Destination、sheet1.Consigned Product；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：sheet1.Date按月、sheet1.Destination、sheet1.Consigned Product；聚合：SUM(sheet1.Profit)、SUM(sheet1.Sales Quantity)、SUM(sheet1.Total Logistics Revenue)；连接：无 |

<details><summary>本轮SQL</summary>

```sql
WITH pm AS (
  SELECT "Consigned Product" AS product, strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY "Consigned Product", strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
),
pm_lag AS (
  SELECT product, month, profit, 
         LAG(profit) OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY month) AS prev_profit
  FROM pm
)
SELECT product,
       SUM(profit - prev_profit) AS total_contribution,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-02' THEN profit - prev_profit END) AS chg_jan_feb,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-03' THEN profit - prev_profit END) AS chg_feb_mar,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-04' THEN profit - prev_profit END) AS chg_mar_apr,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-07' THEN profit - prev_profit END) AS chg_jun_jul
FROM pm_lag WHERE prev_profit IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY product
ORDER BY total_contribution DESC
```

</details>

#### 新轨迹 Q12

本轮返回后复用的间隔：8.989秒。

| 候选 | 本轮预测 |
|---|---|
| 1 | 补充列：sheet1.Date、sheet1.Profit、sheet1.Destination、sheet1.Consigned Product、sheet1.Sales Quantity、sheet1.Total Logistics Revenue；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：sheet1.Date按月、sheet1.Destination、sheet1.Consigned Product；聚合：SUM(sheet1.Profit)、SUM(sheet1.Sales Quantity)、AVG(sheet1.Logistics Unit Price)、SUM(sheet1.Total Logistics Revenue)；连接：无 |

<details><summary>本轮SQL</summary>

```sql
WITH city_m AS (
  SELECT Destination AS city, strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY Destination, strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
)
SELECT city,
       SUM(profit) AS total_profit,
       AVG(profit) AS mean_m,
       SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)) AS sd_m,
       100.0*SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/AVG(profit) AS cv_pct,
       MAX(profit)-MIN(profit) AS range_m
FROM city_m GROUP BY city ORDER BY total_profit DESC
```

</details>

<a id="guided-q13"></a>
#### 新轨迹 Q13

本轮返回后复用的间隔：0.004秒。

| 候选 | 本轮预测 |
|---|---|
| 1 | 补充列：sheet1.Date、sheet1.Profit、sheet1.Destination、sheet1.Consigned Product、sheet1.Sales Quantity、sheet1.Total Logistics Revenue、sheet1.Discount Amount；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：sheet1.Date按月、sheet1.Destination；聚合：SUM(sheet1.Profit)、COUNT(*)、SUM(sheet1.Sales Quantity)；连接：无 |

<details><summary>本轮SQL</summary>

```sql
WITH parts AS (
  SELECT Destination,
         substr(Destination, 1, instr(Destination, '-')-1) AS region,
         substr(Destination, instr(Destination, '-')+1, instr(substr(Destination, instr(Destination, '-')+1), '-')-1) AS province,
         Profit, Date
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
),
prov_m AS (
  SELECT province, strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM parts GROUP BY province, strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
)
SELECT province, SUM(profit) AS total_profit, AVG(profit) AS mean_m,
       SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)) AS sd_m,
       100.0*SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/AVG(profit) AS cv_pct,
       MIN(profit) AS min_m, MAX(profit) AS max_m, MAX(profit)-MIN(profit) AS range_m,
       COUNT(DISTINCT month) AS n_months
FROM prov_m GROUP BY province ORDER BY total_profit DESC
```

</details>

#### 新轨迹 Q14

本轮返回后复用的间隔：17.050秒。

| 候选 | 本轮预测 |
|---|---|
| 1 | 补充列：sheet1.Date、sheet1.Profit、sheet1.Destination、sheet1.Consigned Product、sheet1.Sales Quantity、sheet1.Total Logistics Revenue；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：sheet1.Date按月、sheet1.Destination、sheet1.Consigned Product；聚合：SUM(sheet1.Profit)、SUM(sheet1.Sales Quantity)、COUNT(*)；连接：无 |

<details><summary>本轮SQL</summary>

```sql
WITH cm AS (
  SELECT Destination AS city, strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY Destination, strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
),
cm_lag AS (
  SELECT city, month, profit, LAG(profit) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY month) AS prev_profit FROM cm
)
SELECT city,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-02' THEN profit - prev_profit END) AS chg_jan_feb,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-03' THEN profit - prev_profit END) AS chg_feb_mar,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-04' THEN profit - prev_profit END) AS chg_mar_apr,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-07' THEN profit - prev_profit END) AS chg_jun_jul
FROM cm_lag WHERE prev_profit IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY ABS(chg_jan_feb) DESC
```

</details>

<a id="guided-q15"></a>
#### 新轨迹 Q15

本轮返回后复用的间隔：0.004秒。

| 候选 | 本轮预测 |
|---|---|
| 1 | 补充列：sheet1.Date、sheet1.Profit、sheet1.Destination、sheet1.Consigned Product、sheet1.Sales Quantity、sheet1.Total Logistics Revenue、sheet1.Discount Amount、sheet1.Logistics Value-Added Service Revenue、sheet1.Logistics Unit Price、sheet1.List Price Revenue；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：sheet1.Date按月、sheet1.Consigned Product；聚合：SUM(sheet1.Profit)、SUM(sheet1.Sales Quantity)、SUM(sheet1.Total Logistics Revenue)、SUM(sheet1.Discount Amount)、SUM(sheet1.Logistics Value-Added Service Revenue)、AVG(sheet1.Logistics Unit Price)；连接：无 |

<details><summary>本轮SQL</summary>

```sql
WITH parts AS (
  SELECT Destination AS city, Profit, Date,
         substr(Destination, instr(Destination, '-')+1, instr(substr(Destination, instr(Destination, '-')+1), '-')-1) AS province,
         strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
),
prov_m AS (
  SELECT province, month, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM parts GROUP BY province, month
),
prov_lag AS (
  SELECT province, month, profit,
         LAG(profit) OVER (PARTITION BY province ORDER BY month) AS prev_profit
  FROM prov_m
)
SELECT province, SUM(profit) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(profit)/(SELECT SUM(Profit) FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'), 2) AS pct_of_sc,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-02' THEN profit - prev_profit END), 0) AS chg_feb,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-03' THEN profit - prev_profit END), 0) AS chg_mar,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-04' THEN profit - prev_profit END), 0) AS chg_apr,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-07' THEN profit - prev_profit END), 0) AS chg_jul,
       ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/AVG(profit)*100, 2) AS cv_pct
FROM prov_lag WHERE prev_profit IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY province
ORDER BY total_profit DESC
```

</details>

<details><summary>本轮SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT substr(Destination, 1, instr(Destination, '-')-1) AS region, 
       substr(Destination, instr(Destination, '-')+1, instr(substr(Destination, instr(Destination, '-')+1), '-')-1) AS province,
       COUNT(*) AS n_orders, SUM(Profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT Destination) AS n_cities
FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' 
AND substr(Destination, instr(Destination, '-')+1, instr(substr(Destination, instr(Destination, '-')+1), '-')-1) IN ('Henan Province', 'Hubei Province', 'Hunan Province')
GROUP BY province ORDER BY total_profit DESC
```

</details>

<details><summary>本轮SQL</summary>

```sql
WITH pm AS (
  SELECT "Consigned Product" AS product, strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month,
         SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty, SUM(Profit) AS profit, SUM("Total Logistics Revenue") AS rev,
         SUM("Discount Amount") AS disc, SUM("Logistics Value-Added Service Revenue") AS var
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY "Consigned Product", strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
)
SELECT product, month, ROUND(profit,0) AS profit, ROUND(rev,0) AS rev, qty, ROUND(rev/qty,4) AS rev_per_unit,
       ROUND(disc,0) AS disc, ROUND(var,0) AS var_rev
FROM pm WHERE product IN ('Kitchen Appliances', 'Auto parts', 'Bathroom supplies')
ORDER BY product, month
```

```sql
WITH pm AS (
  SELECT "Consigned Product" AS product, strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month,
         SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty, SUM(Profit) AS profit, SUM("Total Logistics Revenue") AS rev
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY "Consigned Product", strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
)
SELECT product, month, ROUND(profit,0) AS profit, ROUND(rev,0) AS rev, qty, ROUND(rev/qty,4) AS rev_per_unit
FROM pm WHERE product IN ('Kitchen Appliances', 'Bathroom supplies')
ORDER BY product, month
```

#### 新轨迹 Q20

本轮返回后复用的间隔：8.932秒。

| 候选 | 本轮预测 |
|---|---|
| 1 | 补充列：sheet1.Date、sheet1.Profit、sheet1.Destination、sheet1.Consigned Product、sheet1.Sales Quantity、sheet1.Total Logistics Revenue；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：sheet1.Date按月、sheet1.Destination、sheet1.Consigned Product；聚合：SUM(sheet1.Profit)、SUM(sheet1.Sales Quantity)、COUNT(*)；连接：无 |

<details><summary>本轮SQL</summary>

```sql
WITH cm AS (
  SELECT Destination AS city, strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month,
         SUM(Profit) AS profit, SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty, COUNT(*) AS orders
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY Destination, strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
),
cm_lag AS (
  SELECT city, month, profit, qty, orders,
         LAG(profit) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY month) AS prev_profit,
         LAG(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY month) AS prev_qty,
         LAG(orders) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY month) AS prev_orders
  FROM cm
)
SELECT city, ROUND(SUM(profit),0) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-02' THEN profit - prev_profit END),0) AS chg_feb_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-02' THEN qty - prev_qty END),0) AS chg_feb_qty,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-02' THEN orders - prev_orders END),0) AS chg_feb_orders,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-03' THEN profit - prev_profit END),0) AS chg_mar_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-03' THEN qty - prev_qty END),0) AS chg_mar_qty,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-04' THEN profit - prev_profit END),0) AS chg_apr_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-04' THEN qty - prev_qty END),0) AS chg_apr_qty
FROM cm_lag WHERE prev_profit IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-02' THEN profit - prev_profit END)) DESC
LIMIT 15
```

</details>

```sql
-- Check if Henan/Hubei/Hunan provinces also appear under other region labels
SELECT substr(Destination, 1, instr(Destination, '-')-1) AS region,
       substr(Destination, instr(Destination, '-')+1, instr(substr(Destination, instr(Destination, '-')+1), '-')-1) AS province,
```

<details><summary>本轮SQL</summary>

```sql
-- What is the average profit per order and per unit for the volatile months?
-- Compare Feb (low) vs Jan (high) - is it quantity or per-unit value?
WITH m AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month,
         SUM(Profit) AS profit, SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty, COUNT(*) AS orders
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
)
SELECT month, profit, orders, qty, ROUND(profit/orders,2) AS profit_per_order, 
       ROUND(profit/qty,4) AS profit_per_unit
FROM m WHERE month IN ('2023-01','2023-02','2023-03','2023-04','2023-06','2023-07')
ORDER BY month
```

</details>

| 1 | 补充列：sheet1.Date、sheet1.Profit、sheet1.Destination、sheet1.Consigned Product、sheet1.Sales Quantity、sheet1.Total Logistics Revenue、sheet1.Profit Margin、sheet1.Total Logistics Cost、sheet1.List Price Revenue；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：无；聚合：无；连接：无 |

<details><summary>本轮SQL</summary>

```sql
WITH m AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month,
         SUM(Profit) AS profit, SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM("Total Logistics Revenue") AS rev
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_months,
       AVG(profit) AS mean_profit, 100.0*SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/AVG(profit) AS cv_profit,
       AVG(orders) AS mean_orders, 100.0*SQRT(AVG(orders*orders)-AVG(orders)*AVG(orders))/AVG(orders) AS cv_orders,
       AVG(qty) AS mean_qty, 100.0*SQRT(AVG(qty*qty)-AVG(qty)*AVG(qty))/AVG(qty) AS cv_qty,
       AVG(profit/orders) AS mean_ppo, 100.0*SQRT(AVG((profit/orders)*(profit/orders))-AVG(profit/orders)*AVG(profit/orders))/AVG(profit/orders) AS cv_ppo,
       AVG(profit/qty) AS mean_ppu, 100.0*SQRT(AVG((profit/qty)*(profit/qty))-AVG(profit/qty)*AVG(profit/qty))/AVG(profit/qty) AS cv_ppu,
       AVG(rev/orders) AS mean_rpo, 100.0*SQRT(AVG((rev/orders)*(rev/orders))-AVG(rev/orders)*AVG(rev/orders))/AVG(rev/orders) AS cv_rpo
FROM m
```

</details>

<details><summary>本轮SQL</summary>

```sql
-- Concentration of negative profit records by month
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Profit < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_orders,
       100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN Profit < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS neg_pct,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Profit < 0 THEN Profit ELSE 0 END) AS total_neg_profit,
       SUM(Profit) AS total_profit
FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
ORDER BY month
```

| 候选 | 本轮预测 |

| 1 | 补充列：sheet1.Date、sheet1.Profit、sheet1.Destination、sheet1.Consigned Product、sheet1.Sales Quantity、sheet1.Total Logistics Revenue；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：无；聚合：无；连接：无 |

<details><summary>本轮SQL</summary>

```sql
-- Verify: Contribution of each product to monthly profit volatility
-- By computing product-level contribution to overall monthly profit variance
WITH pm AS (
  SELECT "Consigned Product" AS product, strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY "Consigned Product", strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
),
total_m AS (
  SELECT month, SUM(profit) AS total_profit FROM pm GROUP BY month
)
SELECT p.product, 
       ROUND(AVG(p.profit),0) AS mean_profit,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(p.profit)/(SELECT SUM(profit) FROM pm),1) AS share_pct,
       ROUND(SQRT(AVG(p.profit*p.profit)-AVG(p.profit)*AVG(p.profit))/AVG(p.profit)*100,1) AS cv_pct,
       -- Decompose variance contribution: Cov(product, total) contribution to Var(total)
       ROUND(SUM((p.profit - (SELECT AVG(p2.profit) FROM pm p2 WHERE p2.product=p.product)) * 
                  (t.total_profit - (SELECT AVG(total_profit) FROM total_m)))/11.0, 0) AS cov_with_total
FROM pm p JOIN total_m t ON p.month=t.month
GROUP BY p.product
ORDER BY share_pct DESC
```

</details>

<details><summary>本轮SQL</summary>

```sql
WITH m AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month,
         SUM(Profit) AS profit, COUNT(*) AS orders
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
),
lag AS (
  SELECT month, profit, orders,
         LAG(profit) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS p0,
         LAG(orders) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS o0
  FROM m
)
SELECT month, ROUND(profit,0) AS profit, ROUND(p0,0) AS prev_profit,
       ROUND(profit-p0,0) AS total_chg,
       ROUND((orders-o0)*(p0*1.0/o0),0) AS volume_effect,
       ROUND((profit*1.0/orders - p0*1.0/o0)*orders,0) AS per_order_effect,
       ROUND(100.0*(orders-o0)/o0,2) AS orders_pct_chg,
       ROUND(100.0*(profit*1.0/orders - p0*1.0/o0)/(p0*1.0/o0),2) AS per_order_pct_chg
FROM lag WHERE p0 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY month
```

</details>

<details><summary>本轮SQL</summary>

```sql
-- Kitchen Appliances Jan-Feb drop decomposition by province
WITH ka AS (
  SELECT substr(Destination, instr(Destination, '-')+1, instr(substr(Destination, instr(Destination, '-')+1), '-')-1) AS province,
         strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit, COUNT(*) AS orders
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' AND "Consigned Product"='Kitchen Appliances'
  GROUP BY province, strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
)
SELECT province,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-01' THEN profit END),0) AS jan_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-02' THEN profit END),0) AS feb_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-01' THEN orders END),0) AS jan_orders,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-02' THEN orders END),0) AS feb_orders
FROM ka GROUP BY province ORDER BY jan_profit DESC
```

</details>

### 验证范围和资料

- 77项测试通过。新轨迹先进行独立完整结果验证，正式两对再次与来源结果核对，并在普通/FAD组之间直接比较全部结果。保留NULL、重复行、排序及原有错误；浮点绝对容差1e-7、相对1e-9。
- 每次使用新数据库副本、新进程/连接，相同完整预热、WAL和两个逻辑CPU，随机AB/BA串行。副本位于/tmp的tmpfs；这不是物理磁盘冷缓存测试。数据已逐行验证，由原18,250行复制及固定种子抽样扩展，分类基数没有随行数同步增长。
- 本次分析要求和优化调度都与上一次13轮不同；本批对照固定的是这个新会话的同一轨迹，不把跨批差异单独归因为轮数。
- 来源Agent使用独立会话、工作目录和本地配置/缓存/状态目录，仅开放DB工具。服务端可能复用输入前缀缓存；未计生成额外FAD的模型延时，空闲跳过不重现长期空闲时的缓存老化。
- 只按用户要求做两对，保留两对完整结果；尚未进行官方答案质量评分。

## DAComp-006：1,000万行，独立新Agent轨迹

**Agent等待数据库的累计时间：普通 100.799 秒 → 使用FAD 94.389 秒（两组各五次中位数）。每对节省 +5.893～+6.868 秒，节省比例中位数 +6.50%。**

直接复用的典型查询：[Q8](#ten-million-q8)按城市、月份汇总订单数和利润，SQL执行由7.349秒降至0.0067秒，837行结果一致。整条任务的收益按全部13条SQL累计计算。

数据库从原18,250行扩为10,000,000行；独立新会话实际生成13次SQL调用，13次成功。没有沿用旧30轮或13轮SQL。两组固定回放这一次生成的相同SQL/FAD，调用间隔合计1167.667秒，记录后复用，剩余空闲直接跳过。

主指标为每条SQL开始被数据库工具处理至结果返回的累计时间，包含解析、快照、匹配/改写、SQL执行、结果归档、日志和FAD提交的前台开销。后台准备单独计时，已经被Agent间隔覆盖的工作不重复扣除；构建超过间隔时，下一条查询仍按时到达，并发争用由实际查询计时体现。末尾清理另列。

本次Agent曾并发提交Q8～Q10、Q11～Q12，原MCP工具实际串行处理。间隔取数据库请求/完成日志中的服务边界，排队的查询紧接上一条执行，间隔仅约3～7毫秒。原始客户端时间戳保留，不把排队时间变成后台优化窗口，也不把重叠调用的排队等待重复相加。优化策略冻结后只补充了这一时间提取兼容处理；策略和预算未改。

### 五对数据库等待时间

单位秒。节省=普通−使用FAD，比例以各对普通耗时为分母；先配对计算，再取中位数。

| 配对 | 普通执行 | 使用FAD | 节省 | 节省比例 | 加清理后的节省 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 100.792 | 94.389 | +6.402 | +6.35% | +6.363 |
| 2 | 101.253 | 94.416 | +6.838 | +6.75% | +6.798 |
| 3 | 100.670 | 94.128 | +6.541 | +6.50% | +6.502 |
| 4 | 100.878 | 94.009 | +6.868 | +6.81% | +6.829 |
| 5 | 100.799 | 94.907 | +5.893 | +5.85% | +5.853 |

使用FAD更快：5/5对；节省范围+5.893～+6.868秒。130次来源结果核对和65次两组直接比较全部通过。

每次收到13份FAD；13份通过接收，13份包含候选，共接受47个候选。实际直接使用提前准备对象的SQL为[Q8](#ten-million-q8)，共1/13条。这是数据库实际复用数量，与FAD单项预测命中率不是同一个指标。

### 时间花在哪里

| 耗时组成（五次中位数，秒） | 普通 | 使用FAD |
|---|---:|---:|
| SQL执行与结果归档 | 100.796 | 94.333 |
| 前台匹配、原SQL必要预检及改写 | 0 | 0.035 |
| 实际计划检查及索引保护 | 0 | 0.001 |
| 其他前台处理 | 0.003 | 0.013 |
| 后台FAD接收、校验 | 0 | 0.243 |
| 后台实际对象构建 | 0 | 27.811 |
| 构建中与Agent间隔重叠的部分 | 0 | 19.359 |
| 构建中与查询处理重叠的部分 | 0 | 8.476 |
| 末尾停止、清理及关闭 | 0.001 | 0.041 |

构建重叠两行是构建耗时的子集，不能与整列相加。后台决策总时长（包含构建、统计等）中位数为29.430秒。各项独立取中位数，分项相加不一定等于总时间中位数。

### 本次优化实现

在查看新轨迹内容之前冻结了v1.4策略：汇总匹配规则后台预编译；相同过滤和分组的已收到聚合指标合并准备，增补版本不占新的方向名额；最多12个汇总方向，仍受512MiB总空间和时间预算约束。汇总表直接一次扫描构建，以SQLite页数上限保护空间，省去此前重复的聚合估计扫描。

聚合预测准备汇总表。明细预测才尝试含明确投影列的索引，首列过滤匹配比例须在0～10%；重复过滤统计缓存。当前查询计划如果选择需要大量回表的FAD索引，则回退原表；既有浮点舍入保护保留。所有动作来自已到达的FAD和当前数据库统计，优化器不接收未来SQL或未来间隔。

### 每个对象的触发、准备时间和实际使用

只统计实际建成次数；同一对象在不同配对的就绪时机会变化。构建和使用次数按五次使用FAD回放统计。

### 为什么有预测，却没有全部转成加速

这次47个候选中，同一预测会随多轮SQL重复更新。建出的对象数量和实际提速的查询数量，不能与47直接等同。下面区分预测本身缺的信息和当前优化器的限制。

| 查询 | 本次没有复用的具体原因 |
|---|---|
| Q1～Q3 | 起初没有更早的可用对象；Q1/Q2的过滤范围仍为unknown。 |
| Q4（月度收支） | Q1/Q2预测了月度指标，但华南过滤值未定；本版只为过滤条件完整的预测建汇总表。 |
| Q5（产品收支） | 已建产品汇总表缺少实际SQL中的运费、仓储费和其他运营成本三个SUM。不能用不完整结果替代整条查询。 |
| Q6（月×产品利润） | 预测已给出，但每轮最多构建一个对象，排在其他方向后面；对应对象到Q6结束后才构建。这是当前调度限制。 |
| Q7（全表区域×月） | 实际按Destination截取的区域分组、访问全表；已有预测主要是华南完整Destination分组。 |
| Q9（月×产品收支） | 同分组的已建汇总表缺少销量、收入、成本的SUM；产品维度的另一个表没有月份，不能补齐。 |
| Q10（月度量价） | 月度方向缺少完整、可构建的预测，所需销量和单价聚合也未在该方向完整给出。 |
| Q11/Q12（年龄、性别×月） | FAD只写了年龄/性别分组，实际SQL还加了月份；已有表已丢掉月度信息。 |
| Q13（省份条件聚合） | 实际SUM(CASE WHEN …)没有对应的提前汇总规则，本版也不支持从城市汇总安全转换这种条件聚合。 |

Q8的过滤、月份和城市分组、COUNT(*)、SUM(Profit)与提前准备的对象一致，所以能直接读取小汇总表。未利用对象的构建和清理仍保留在统计中；Q6错过的机会也没有被记为收益。

<details><summary>原始SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM("List Price Revenue"),2) AS list_rev, ROUND(SUM("Logistics Value-Added Service Revenue"),2) AS vas_rev, ROUND(SUM("Discount Amount"),2) AS discount, ROUND(SUM("Total Logistics Revenue"),2) AS total_rev, ROUND(SUM("Freight Cost"),2) AS freight_cost, ROUND(SUM("Warehousing Cost"),2) AS warehousing_cost, ROUND(SUM("Other Operating Costs"),2) AS other_cost, ROUND(SUM("Total Logistics Cost"),2) AS total_cost, ROUND(SUM("Profit"),2) AS profit FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") ORDER BY month
```

```sql
SELECT "Consigned Product" AS product, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty, ROUND(SUM("Total Logistics Revenue"),2) AS rev, ROUND(SUM("Freight Cost"),2) AS freight, ROUND(SUM("Warehousing Cost"),2) AS wh, ROUND(SUM("Other Operating Costs"),2) AS other, ROUND(SUM("Total Logistics Cost"),2) AS cost, ROUND(SUM("Profit"),2) AS profit FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY "Consigned Product" ORDER BY profit DESC
```

```sql
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS month, "Consigned Product" AS product, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM("Profit"),2) AS profit FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY month, "Consigned Product" ORDER BY month, profit DESC
```


### 独立性、正确性和适用范围

- [新来源会话](../async/source-ten-million-01/summary.json)使用独立进程、Session ID、工作目录及本地配置/数据/缓存/状态目录。模型为glm-custom/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731；没有给Agent旧SQL/FAD或报告。采集时仅正常执行SQL，未启用数据库优化。
- 数据逐行校验血缘：547份完整复制和17,250行固定种子抽样，新增运单号唯一，原有53个重复运单号保留。行数增长，日期范围、产品和目的地类别未同比增长；这是扩容可行性实验。
- 两组每次新数据库副本、新进程/连接，相同完整预热、WAL与缓存设置，两个相同逻辑CPU，随机AB/BA串行。副本位于/tmp的tmpfs；不代表物理磁盘或冷缓存结果。
- 优化相关68项测试和新增3项排队调用时间测试通过；新轨迹独立验证和正式130次来源核对、65次两组直接比较通过。核对NULL、重复行和排序；浮点绝对1e-7、相对1e-9。
- 原始SQL、FAD、客户端间隔、数据和代码哈希冻结。后台对象提交后才可见；索引及汇总表的实际使用均有计划和时间戳证据。
- 主结论只针对这条新轨迹。之前18,250行30轮和百万行13轮是不同来源，本次优化实现也升级，不能把跨批时间差解释成单纯的数据规模收益。
- 未计额外生成FAD的模型延时；服务端可能复用输入前缀缓存。复用的间隔包含模型服务、客户端和其他工具活动，只模拟时间，不复现模型资源竞争；空闲跳过不重现长期空闲的缓存老化。
- 后台工作被覆盖仍有资源成本；本报告记录所有已建对象及未复用情况。只用五对进行初步验证，不据此声称所有任务都能提速。

## 原始任务六：18,250行，报告中的30轮轨迹

**按相同优化策略实测，这条原始轨迹没有获得更高的净收益：数据库查询处理耗时 252.5 ms → 459.6 ms，配对中位数增加 208.2 ms（82.6%）。**

数据就是原始dacomp-006.sqlite，18,250行；SQL/FAD就是[原FAD分析报告中任务六](../../tool-prototype/v0.2/trajectory-review/REPORT.md#task-006)的dacomp-006-02会话，30次SQL调用，29次成功。Q10原有错误保留，两组都出现相同错误。没有扩容或重新生成轨迹。

本次与上一批13轮百万行实验使用完全相同的优化代码和配置。后台按已到达FAD准备，原客户端间隔358.049秒直接复用，剩余空闲跳过；主指标累计SQL到达至结果返回的时间。后台构建、前台处理和末尾清理分别列出。

### 五对结果

单位ms；净节省=普通−使用FAD，负数表示变慢。

| 配对 | 普通查询处理 | 使用FAD查询处理 | 净节省 | 净节省比例 | 加清理后的净节省 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 252.8 | 470.2 | -217.4 | -86.0% | -252.1 |
| 2 | 252.5 | 461.1 | -208.6 | -82.6% | -243.9 |
| 3 | 253.8 | 458.0 | -204.2 | -80.5% | -239.6 |
| 4 | 251.4 | 459.6 | -208.2 | -82.8% | -243.8 |
| 5 | 251.4 | 446.7 | -195.3 | -77.7% | -231.6 |

使用FAD更快：0/5对。300次回放调用与来源核对、150次两组直接比较全部通过。接受30份FAD，其中29份有预测、1份无后续预测，58个候选全部接受。

### 查询确实省了部分工作，前台开销抵消了收益

| 耗时组成，五次中位数，ms | 普通 | 使用FAD |
|---|---:|---:|
| SQL执行和结果归档 | 247.9 | 232.6 |
| 前台匹配、预检、改写 | 0 | 128.2 |
| 记录执行计划 | 0 | 2.8 |
| 其余前台处理（快照、提交FAD、日志、返回等） | 4.6 | 95.9 |
| 任务结束后停止和清理（不在上述主指标中） | 0.4 | 35.8 |

各项分别取中位数，列内相加不一定严格等于总时间中位数。其余前台时间由实际时间戳相减得到，没有进一步归因到某个线程或操作。

这条轨迹确实有重复访问，华南按月份、产品汇总的结果用于Q13、Q15、Q21。但原始小库的查询只需要几毫秒；当前Python匹配/改写和请求处理也是毫秒级，节省的扫描工作不足以支付前台开销。

| 实际复用的SQL | 普通SQL执行，ms | 复用后的SQL执行，ms | 普通整轮处理，ms | 复用后整轮处理，ms |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|

### 实际准备了什么

| 对象 | 触发FAD | 构建耗时，ms | 后续实际使用 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| 汇总表1 | Q1、Q2 | 26.43 | 未使用 |
| 汇总表2 | Q4、Q5 | 18.65 | [Q13](#original30-q13)、[Q15](#original30-q15)、[Q21](#original30-q21) |

后台构建合计 45.11 ms，其中 45.11 ms 在Agent间隔内，0.00 ms 与查询重叠。后台接收FAD 324.70 ms；这些成本单独保留，没有再次加到前台查询时间。

汇总表1统计所有地区的月度利润，没有保留目的地，无法再筛选华南；它未被使用。汇总表2保留华南的月份、产品及利润/销量/收入三个指标，确实用于三条查询。两个固定名额用满后，后来的其他汇总预测没有得到构建机会。

当前还要求过滤和分组严格对应、所需聚合已存储。例如Q7多需要Total Logistics Cost求和，而汇总表2没有该指标，所以不能替换。原报告的“候选命中”只要求任意一项被后续使用，并不等于整条查询可由这个候选生成的汇总表替代。

**汇总表1实际DDL**

```sql
CREATE TABLE "fad_m_cf64ff7bd49b2a08" AS SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS "g0", SUM("Profit") AS "a0" FROM "sheet1" NOT INDEXED GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', "Date")
```

**汇总表2实际DDL**

```sql
CREATE TABLE "fad_m_85081ec051408661" AS SELECT "Consigned Product" AS "g0", strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS "g1", SUM("Profit") AS "a0", SUM("Sales Quantity") AS "a1", SUM("Total Logistics Revenue") AS "a2" FROM "sheet1" NOT INDEXED WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY "Consigned Product", strftime('%Y-%m', "Date")
```

<details><summary>原始SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(profit), 0) AS avg_profit,
  ROUND(STDEV(profit), 0) AS std_profit,
  ROUND(STDEV(profit)/AVG(profit)*100, 1) AS cv_profit_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(revenue), 0) AS avg_revenue,
  ROUND(STDEV(revenue), 0) AS std_revenue,
  ROUND(STDEV(revenue)/AVG(revenue)*100, 1) AS cv_revenue_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(cost), 0) AS avg_cost,
  ROUND(STDEV(cost), 0) AS std_cost,
  ROUND(STDEV(cost)/AVG(cost)*100, 1) AS cv_cost_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(qty), 0) AS avg_qty,
  ROUND(STDEV(qty), 0) AS std_qty,
  ROUND(STDEV(qty)/AVG(qty)*100, 1) AS cv_qty_pct
FROM (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, 
    SUM(Profit) AS profit, 
    SUM("Total Logistics Revenue") AS revenue, 
    SUM("Total Logistics Cost") AS cost,
    SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty
  FROM sheet1 
  WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' 
  GROUP BY month
)
```

```text
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(profit), 0) AS avg_profit,
```
```sql
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit) - AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)), 0) AS std_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit) - AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/AVG(profit)*100, 1) AS cv_profit_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(revenue), 0) AS avg_revenue,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(revenue*revenue) - AVG(revenue)*AVG(revenue)), 0) AS std_revenue,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(revenue*revenue) - AVG(revenue)*AVG(revenue))/AVG(revenue)*100, 1) AS cv_revenue_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(cost), 0) AS avg_cost,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(cost*cost) - AVG(cost)*AVG(cost)), 0) AS std_cost,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(cost*cost) - AVG(cost)*AVG(cost))/AVG(cost)*100, 1) AS cv_cost_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(qty), 0) AS avg_qty,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(qty*qty) - AVG(qty)*AVG(qty)), 0) AS std_qty,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(qty*qty) - AVG(qty)*AVG(qty))/AVG(qty)*100, 1) AS cv_qty_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(orders), 0) AS avg_orders,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(orders*orders) - AVG(orders)*AVG(orders)), 0) AS std_orders,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(orders*orders) - AVG(orders)*AVG(orders))/AVG(orders)*100, 1) AS cv_orders_pct
FROM (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, 
    SUM(Profit) AS profit, 
    SUM("Total Logistics Revenue") AS revenue, 
    SUM("Total Logistics Cost") AS cost,
    SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty,
    COUNT(*) AS orders
  FROM sheet1 
  WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' 
  GROUP BY month
)
```

<details><summary>原始SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT "Consigned Product", 
  ROUND(AVG(profit),0) AS avg_monthly_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)),0) AS std_monthly_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/AVG(profit)*100,1) AS cv_pct,
  MIN(profit) AS min_m, MAX(profit) AS max_m,
  ROUND(MAX(profit)-MIN(profit),0) AS range_m,
  SUM(profit) AS total_profit,
  SUM(qty) AS total_qty
FROM (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, "Consigned Product" AS product, 
    SUM(Profit) AS profit, SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY month, product
)
GROUP BY product ORDER BY std_monthly_profit DESC
```

| 2（high） | 补充列：sheet1.Date、sheet1.Consigned Product、sheet1.Profit；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：sheet1.Date按月、sheet1.Consigned Product；聚合：SUM(sheet1.Profit)；连接：无 |

<details><summary>原始SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT Destination,
  ROUND(AVG(profit),0) AS avg_monthly_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)),0) AS std_monthly_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/NULLIF(AVG(profit),0)*100,1) AS cv_pct,
  ROUND(MAX(profit)-MIN(profit),0) AS range_m,
  SUM(profit) AS total_profit
FROM (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, Destination, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY month, Destination
)
GROUP BY Destination ORDER BY std_monthly_profit DESC LIMIT 20
```

</details>

<details><summary>原始SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT product AS prod, 
  ROUND(AVG(profit),0) AS avg_monthly_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)),0) AS std_monthly_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/NULLIF(AVG(profit),0)*100,1) AS cv_pct,
```

<details><summary>原始SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT CASE WHEN Destination LIKE 'South China-Guangdong%' THEN 'Guangdong' WHEN Destination LIKE 'South China-Guangxi%' THEN 'Guangxi' WHEN Destination LIKE 'South China-Hainan%' THEN 'Hainan' ELSE 'Henan' END AS region, strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY region, month ORDER BY region, month
```

<details><summary>原始SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT month, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN prod='Auto parts' THEN profit END) AS auto_parts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prod='Bathroom supplies' THEN profit END) AS bathroom,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prod='Bedding set' THEN profit END) AS bedding,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prod='Bedroom Furniture' THEN profit END) AS bedroom,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prod='Computer hardware' THEN profit END) AS computer,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prod='Home decor items' THEN profit END) AS home_decor,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prod='Kitchen Appliances' THEN profit END) AS kitchen,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prod='Office furniture' THEN profit END) AS office
FROM (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, "Consigned Product" AS prod, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY month, prod
) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
```

| 2（high） | 补充列：sheet1.Date、sheet1.Destination、sheet1.Profit；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：sheet1.Date按月、sheet1.Destination；聚合：SUM(sheet1.Profit)；连接：无 |

<details><summary>原始SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT month, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN dest LIKE '%Guangdong%' THEN profit END) AS guangdong,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dest LIKE '%Guangxi%' THEN profit END) AS guangxi,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dest LIKE '%Hainan%' THEN profit END) AS hainan,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dest LIKE '%Henan%' THEN profit END) AS henan,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dest NOT LIKE '%Guangdong%' AND dest NOT LIKE '%Guangxi%' AND dest NOT LIKE '%Hainan%' AND dest NOT LIKE '%Henan%' THEN profit END) AS other
FROM (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, Destination AS dest, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY month, dest
) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
```

</details>

```text
  SUM(CASE WHEN dest NOT LIKE '%Guangdong%' AND dest NOT LIKE '%Guangxi%' AND dest NOT LIKE '%Hainan%' AND dest NOT LIKE '%Henan%' THEN profit END) AS other
FROM (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, Destination AS dest, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY month, dest
) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
```

| 2（high） | 补充列：sheet1.Date、sheet1.Destination、sheet1.Profit；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：sheet1.Date按月、sheet1.Destination；聚合：SUM(sheet1.Profit)；连接：无 |

<details><summary>原始SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN province='Guangdong Province' THEN profit END) AS guangdong,
  SUM(CASE WHEN province='Guangxi' THEN profit END) AS guangxi,
  SUM(CASE WHEN province='Hainan Province' THEN profit END) AS hainan,
  SUM(CASE WHEN province='Henan Province' THEN profit END) AS henan,
  SUM(CASE WHEN province='Hubei Province' THEN profit END) AS hubei,
  SUM(CASE WHEN province='Hunan Province' THEN profit END) AS hunan
FROM (
  SELECT substr(Destination, 13, instr(substr(Destination, 13)||'-', '-')-1) AS province,
    strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY province, month
) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
```

</details>

### 结论范围与原始证据

在原始18,250行、30轮轨迹上，当前相同策略没有净提速。它显示了实际汇总复用，也显示出前台开销与对象名额限制。上一实验是百万行、另一条13轮轨迹，两者同时改变数据规模和查询内容，不能把比例差直接归因于SQL轮数或FAD数量。

每对全新数据库副本、进程和连接，相同预热、WAL、两个逻辑CPU和随机AB/BA；/tmp为tmpfs。没有修改优化代码或配置去适配本批结果。空闲跳过，间隔沿用原客户端记录，不包含额外生成FAD的模型成本。

## DAComp-006：百万行，固定13轮SQL/FAD

**数据库查询处理耗时：普通 7.862 秒 → 使用FAD 6.818 秒；五对配对结果的中位数节省 1.044 秒（13.27%）。**

主指标只累计每条SQL到达至结果返回的时间，包含快照、匹配/改写、查询、结果归档、日志和提交FAD的前台开销。后台校验、统计、构建及末尾清理单独报告；被Agent间隔覆盖的部分不重复扣除。

本次沿用上一批失败实验的同一条13轮轨迹，没有重新调用Agent。固定间隔788.051秒复用，后台工作实际执行，结束后跳过剩余空闲。若构建未结束而间隔到期，下一条查询仍按时到达，保留实际并发。

| 轨迹 | 来源 | SQL调用数 | 与本次关系 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| 最早的FAD预测分析 | [dacomp-006-02](../../tool-prototype/v0.2/runs/dacomp-006-02/summary.json) | 30（29成功） | 原18,250行数据；下方旧串行实验沿用它 |
| 本次与上一批失败实验 | [source-million-02](../async/source-million-02/summary.json) | 13（全部成功） | 百万行独立会话；两批输入完全相同 |

**每次接受13/13轮FAD，共41个候选；所有130次回放查询与来源完整结果一致，65次两组直接比较一致。**

### 五对数据库耗时

单位秒。节省比例按每对普通耗时作分母；中位数先配对相减再计算。

|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 7.862 | 6.818 | +1.044 | +13.27% | +0.874 |
| 2 | 7.833 | 6.800 | +1.033 | +13.19% | +0.861 |
| 3 | 7.843 | 6.996 | +0.846 | +10.79% | +0.676 |
| 4 | 7.889 | 6.764 | +1.125 | +14.26% | +0.955 |
| 5 | 7.883 | 6.834 | +1.049 | +13.30% | +0.876 |

使用FAD更快：5/5对。节省范围 +0.846～+1.125 秒。

### 收益具体来自哪里

本次改动：按SQL作用域匹配WITH内部的单表聚合，使提前建好的汇总表可以用于外层分析；同时对非覆盖索引检查首列过滤的真实匹配行数。没有明确首列过滤、零匹配或匹配超过全表10%的索引不建。10%为固定保守规则，不是精确收益预测。

构建依然只看已收到的FAD及当前数据，不看未来SQL。同一方向在不同轮出现两次才可构建；最多两张汇总表、两个索引，每轮最多一次DDL尝试。拒绝索引后，同轮其余满足条件的汇总表仍可进入构建。

### 每个准备动作：耗时与实际复用

单位秒，分别取五次中位数。构建全程包括空间估计扫描和CREATE；索引是否准入的过滤计数另列，避免遗漏。

| 对象 | 触发FAD轮次 | 估计及CREATE前处理 | CREATE至提交 | 构建全程 | 实际使用 |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|

| 索引1 | [Q4](#async-q4)、[Q5](#async-q5)、[Q6](#async-q6) | 0.371 | 0.909 | 1.282 | 未使用 |

后台FAD接收/校验 0.233 秒；索引准入检查 1.135 秒；实际对象构建 5.752 秒。前台匹配/改写 0.090 秒，记录计划 0.002 秒，均已计入主指标。

构建与Agent间隔重叠 5.752 秒，与查询处理重叠 0.000 秒。末尾停止/清理：普通 0.000 秒、使用FAD 0.171 秒；加上清理后节省的配对中位数 +0.874 秒。

后台成本虽然没有重复计入查询等待，仍真实消耗资源。未被采用的索引也保留构建、空间和清理成本，不算作有效收益。

本次拦住的宽范围索引：首列条件Destination LIKE South China%匹配371,782/1,000,000行（37.18%），超过10%准入线；纯月份索引没有明确的首列筛选条件，也不再盲目构建。不是按Q编号禁用某条SQL的索引。

<details><summary>原始SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT "Destination", COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(SUM("Profit"), 2) AS total_profit
FROM "sheet1"
GROUP BY "Destination"
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS n_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT "Waybill Number") AS n_waybills,
       SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty,
       ROUND(SUM("List Price Revenue"),2) AS list_rev,
       ROUND(SUM("Logistics Value-Added Service Revenue"),2) AS vas_rev,
       ROUND(SUM("Discount Amount"),2) AS discount,
       ROUND(SUM("Total Logistics Revenue"),2) AS total_rev,
       ROUND(SUM("Freight Cost"),2) AS freight_cost,
       ROUND(SUM("Warehousing Cost"),2) AS wh_cost,
       ROUND(SUM("Other Operating Costs"),2) AS other_cost,
       ROUND(SUM("Total Logistics Cost"),2) AS total_cost,
       ROUND(SUM("Profit"),2) AS profit
FROM "sheet1"
WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', "Date")
ORDER BY month;
```

<a id="async-q4"></a>
#### Q4

查询使用：原表。本轮FAD触发新建：汇总表1。本轮后复用间隔：21.979秒。

| 候选 | 本轮FAD实际预测 |
|---|---|
| 1（high） | 补充列：空列表（标成known）；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：sheet1.Date按月、sheet1.Destination；聚合：SUM(sheet1.Profit)；连接：无 |
| 2（medium） | 补充列：空列表（标成known）；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：sheet1.Date按月、sheet1.Age Range；聚合：SUM(sheet1.Profit)；连接：无 |
| 3（medium） | 补充列：空列表（标成known）；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：sheet1.Date按月；聚合：SUM(sheet1.List Price Revenue)、SUM(sheet1.Logistics Value-Added Service Revenue)、SUM(sheet1.Discount Amount)、SUM(sheet1.Freight Cost)、SUM(sheet1.Warehousing Cost)、SUM(sheet1.Other Operating Costs)、SUM(sheet1.Profit)；连接：无 |
| 4（low） | 补充列：空列表（标成known）；过滤：sheet1.Profit lt 0；分组：无；聚合：COUNT(sheet1.Profit)；连接：无 |
<details><summary>原始SQL</summary>

```sql
WITH pm AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS m, "Consigned Product" AS p, SUM("Profit") AS x
  FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY 1,2
),
t AS (SELECT m, SUM(x) AS tm FROM pm GROUP BY m),
tot AS (SELECT AVG(tm) AS mt, SUM(tm*tm) AS st2 FROM t),
pd AS (SELECT p, SUM(x) AS sx, SUM(x*tm) AS sxt
       FROM pm JOIN t ON pm.m = t.m GROUP BY p),
varcalc AS (SELECT st2/12 - mt*mt AS var_total FROM tot)
SELECT pd.p AS product,
       ROUND(pd.sx, 0) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(pd.sx / (SELECT SUM(tm) FROM t) * 100, 1) AS profit_share_pct,
       ROUND((pd.sxt/12 - (pd.sx/12.0) * (SELECT mt FROM tot)) / (SELECT var_total FROM varcalc) * 100, 1) AS variance_contribution_pct
FROM pd, varcalc
ORDER BY variance_contribution_pct DESC;
```

</details>

```text
WITH pm AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS m, "Consigned Product" AS p, SUM("Profit") AS x
  FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY 1,2
),
t AS (SELECT m, SUM(x) AS tm FROM pm GROUP BY m),
tot AS (SELECT AVG(tm) AS mt, SUM(tm*tm) AS st2 FROM t),
pd AS (SELECT p, SUM(x) AS sx, SUM(x*tm) AS sxt
       FROM pm JOIN t ON pm.m = t.m GROUP BY p),
varcalc AS (SELECT st2/12 - mt*mt AS var_total FROM tot)
SELECT pd.p AS product,
       ROUND(pd.sx, 0) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(pd.sx / (SELECT SUM(tm) FROM t) * 100, 1) AS profit_share_pct,
       ROUND((pd.sxt/12 - (pd.sx/12.0) * (SELECT mt FROM tot)) / (SELECT var_total FROM varcalc) * 100, 1) AS variance_contribution_pct
FROM pd, varcalc
ORDER BY variance_contribution_pct DESC;
```

#### Q5

查询使用：汇总表1。本轮FAD触发新建：汇总表2。本轮后复用间隔：38.443秒。

| 候选 | 本轮FAD实际预测 |
|---|---|
| 1（medium） | 补充列：空列表（标成known）；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：sheet1.Date按月、sheet1.Age Range；聚合：SUM(sheet1.Profit)；连接：无 |
| 2（medium） | 补充列：空列表（标成known）；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：sheet1.Date按月；聚合：SUM(sheet1.List Price Revenue)、SUM(sheet1.Logistics Value-Added Service Revenue)、SUM(sheet1.Discount Amount)、SUM(sheet1.Freight Cost)、SUM(sheet1.Warehousing Cost)、SUM(sheet1.Other Operating Costs)、SUM(sheet1.Profit)；连接：无 |
| 3（low） | 补充列：空列表（标成known）；过滤：sheet1.Profit lt 0；分组：无；聚合：COUNT(sheet1.Profit)；连接：无 |
<details><summary>原始SQL</summary>

```sql
WITH dm AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS m, "Destination" AS d, SUM("Profit") AS x
  FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY 1,2
),
t AS (SELECT m, SUM(x) AS tm FROM dm GROUP BY m),
tot AS (SELECT AVG(tm) AS mt, SUM(tm*tm) AS st2 FROM t),
dd AS (SELECT d, SUM(x) AS sx, SUM(x*tm) AS sxt
       FROM dm JOIN t ON dm.m = t.m GROUP BY d),
varcalc AS (SELECT st2/12 - mt*mt AS var_total FROM tot)
SELECT dd.d AS destination,
       ROUND(dd.sx, 0) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(dd.sx / (SELECT SUM(tm) FROM t) * 100, 1) AS profit_share_pct,
       ROUND((dd.sxt/12 - (dd.sx/12.0) * (SELECT mt FROM tot)) / (SELECT var_total FROM varcalc) * 100, 1) AS variance_contribution_pct
FROM dd, varcalc
ORDER BY variance_contribution_pct DESC
LIMIT 15;
```

</details>

#### Q6

查询使用：汇总表2。本轮FAD触发新建：索引1。本轮后复用间隔：43.564秒。

| 候选 | 本轮FAD实际预测 |
|---|---|
| 1（low） | 补充列：空列表（标成known）；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：sheet1.Date按月、sheet1.Customer Gender；聚合：SUM(sheet1.Profit)；连接：无 |
| 2（medium） | 补充列：空列表（标成known）；过滤：sheet1.Destination like "South China%"；分组：sheet1.Date按月；聚合：SUM(sheet1.List Price Revenue)、SUM(sheet1.Logistics Value-Added Service Revenue)、SUM(sheet1.Discount Amount)、SUM(sheet1.Freight Cost)、SUM(sheet1.Warehousing Cost)、SUM(sheet1.Other Operating Costs)、SUM(sheet1.Profit)；连接：无 |
| 3（low） | 补充列：空列表（标成known）；过滤：sheet1.Profit lt 0；分组：无；聚合：COUNT(sheet1.Profit)；连接：无 |
<details><summary>原始SQL</summary>

```sql
WITH am AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS m, "Age Range" AS a, SUM("Profit") AS x
  FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY 1,2
),
t AS (SELECT m, SUM(x) AS tm FROM am GROUP BY m),
tot AS (SELECT AVG(tm) AS mt, SUM(tm*tm) AS st2 FROM t),
ad AS (SELECT a, SUM(x) AS sx, SUM(x*tm) AS sxt
       FROM am JOIN t ON am.m = t.m GROUP BY a),
varcalc AS (SELECT st2/12 - mt*mt AS var_total FROM tot)
SELECT ad.a AS age_range,
       ROUND(ad.sx, 0) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(ad.sx / (SELECT SUM(tm) FROM t) * 100, 1) AS profit_share_pct,
       ROUND((ad.sxt/12 - (ad.sx/12.0) * (SELECT mt FROM tot)) / (SELECT var_total FROM varcalc) * 100, 1) AS variance_contribution_pct
FROM ad, varcalc
ORDER BY variance_contribution_pct DESC;
```

</details>

<details><summary>原始SQL</summary>

```sql
WITH t AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS m,
         SUM("List Price Revenue") AS L,
         SUM("Logistics Value-Added Service Revenue") AS V,
         SUM("Discount Amount") AS D,
         SUM("Freight Cost") AS F,
         SUM("Warehousing Cost") AS W,
         SUM("Other Operating Costs") AS O,
         SUM("Profit") AS P
  FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY 1
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(L) aL, AVG(V) aV, AVG(D) aD, AVG(F) aF, AVG(W) aW, AVG(O) aO, AVG(P) aP,
         AVG(L*P) cL, AVG(V*P) cV, AVG(D*P) cD, AVG(F*P) cF, AVG(W*P) cW, AVG(O*P) cO,
         AVG(P*P) cP
  FROM t
)
SELECT ROUND(cP - aP*aP, 0) AS var_profit,
       ROUND((cL - aL*aP) / (cP - aP*aP) * 100, 1) AS list_revenue_pct,
       ROUND((cV - aV*aP) / (cP - aP*aP) * 100, 1) AS vas_revenue_pct,
       ROUND(-(cD - aD*aP) / (cP - aP*aP) * 100, 1) AS discount_pct,
       ROUND(-(cF - aF*aP) / (cP - aP*aP) * 100, 1) AS freight_cost_pct,
       ROUND(-(cW - aW*aP) / (cP - aP*aP) * 100, 1) AS warehousing_cost_pct,
       ROUND(-(cO - aO*aP) / (cP - aP*aP) * 100, 1) AS other_operating_cost_pct
FROM a;
```

```sql
WITH m(mo, p, q) AS (VALUES
 ('2023-01', 41260843.32, 1571450),
 ('2023-02', 34930169.60, 1393456),
 ('2023-03', 41416325.14, 1664735),
 ('2023-04', 37502052.15, 1481441),
 ('2023-05', 39090303.53, 1479399),
 ('2023-06', 36952205.64, 1458864),
 ('2023-07', 42338268.91, 1575898),
 ('2023-08', 42441103.11, 1697350),
 ('2023-09', 42152029.70, 1568713),
 ('2023-10', 41860074.00, 1605695),
 ('2023-11', 40748961.59, 1512502),
 ('2023-12', 43280459.17, 1621505)
),
x AS (SELECT p, q, 1.0*p/q AS u FROM m),
s AS (SELECT AVG(p) ap, AVG(q) aq, AVG(u) au,
             AVG(q*p) cqp, AVG(u*p) cup, AVG(p*p) cpp, AVG(q*q) cqq, AVG(u*u) cuu
      FROM x),
v AS (SELECT cqp - aq*ap AS cov_qp, cup - au*ap AS cov_up, cpp - ap*ap AS var_p,
             (cqq - aq*aq)/(aq*aq) AS cv2_q, (cuu - au*au)/(au*au) AS cv2_u,
             ap, aq, au
      FROM s)
SELECT ROUND(var_p, 0) AS var_profit,
       ROUND(cv2_q, 5) AS cv2_qty,
       ROUND(cv2_u, 5) AS cv2_unit,
       ROUND(au * cov_qp / var_p * 100, 1) AS volume_share_pct,
       ROUND(aq * cov_up / var_p * 100, 1) AS unit_share_pct,
       ROUND(100 - au * cov_qp / var_p * 100 - aq * cov_up / var_p * 100, 1) AS interaction_pct
FROM v;
```

```sql
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "Profit" < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_profit_orders,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "Profit" < 0 THEN "Profit" ELSE 0 END), 2) AS negative_profit_sum,
       ROUND(MIN("Profit"), 2) AS min_order_profit,
       ROUND(MAX("Profit"), 2) AS max_order_profit,
       ROUND(AVG("Profit"), 2) AS avg_order_profit,
       COUNT(*) AS n_orders
```

<details><summary>原始SQL</summary>

```sql
WITH gm AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS m, "Customer Gender" AS g, SUM("Profit") AS x
  FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY 1,2
),
t AS (SELECT m, SUM(x) AS tm FROM gm GROUP BY m),
tot AS (SELECT AVG(tm) AS mt, SUM(tm*tm) AS st2 FROM t),
gd AS (SELECT g, SUM(x) AS sx, SUM(x*tm) AS sxt
       FROM gm JOIN t ON gm.m = t.m GROUP BY g),
varcalc AS (SELECT st2/12 - mt*mt AS var_total FROM tot)
SELECT gd.g AS gender,
       ROUND(gd.sx, 0) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(gd.sx / (SELECT SUM(tm) FROM t) * 100, 1) AS profit_share_pct,
       ROUND((gd.sxt/12 - (gd.sx/12.0) * (SELECT mt FROM tot)) / (SELECT var_total FROM varcalc) * 100, 1) AS variance_contribution_pct
FROM gd, varcalc
ORDER BY variance_contribution_pct DESC;
```

</details>

<details><summary>原始SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty,
       ROUND(SUM("Profit"), 0) AS profit
FROM "sheet1"
WHERE "Destination" = 'South China-Guangdong Province-Foshan'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
```

</details>

<details><summary>实际执行SQL与计划</summary>

<a id="async-q13"></a>
#### Q13

查询使用：原表。本轮FAD触发新建：无。本轮后复用间隔：109.691秒。

| 候选 | 本轮FAD实际预测 |
|---|---|
| 1（medium） | 补充列：空列表（标成known）；过滤：sheet1.Destination eq "South China-Guangdong Province-Foshan"；分组：sheet1.Date按月；聚合：SUM(sheet1.Profit)、SUM(sheet1.Sales Quantity)；连接：无 |
| 2（medium） | 补充列：空列表（标成known）；过滤：(sheet1.Destination like "South China%" 且 sheet1.Consigned Product eq "Kitchen Appliances")；分组：sheet1.Date按月；聚合：SUM(sheet1.Profit)、SUM(sheet1.Sales Quantity)；连接：无 |
<details><summary>原始SQL</summary>

```sql
WITH rm AS (
  SELECT substr("Destination", 1, instr("Destination", '-') - 1) AS region,
         strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS m,
         SUM("Profit") AS p
  FROM "sheet1" GROUP BY 1, 2
),
s AS (
  SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(p) AS mp, SUM(p*p) AS sp2, MIN(p) AS mnp, MAX(p) AS mxp
  FROM rm GROUP BY region
)
SELECT region, n AS months,
       ROUND(mp, 0) AS mean_monthly_profit,
       ROUND(mnp, 0) AS min_monthly,
       ROUND(mxp, 0) AS max_monthly,
       ROUND((mxp - mnp) / mp * 100, 1) AS range_pct_of_mean,
       ROUND((sp2/n - mp*mp) / (mp*mp), 5) AS cv_squared
FROM s
ORDER BY cv_squared DESC;
```

</details>

```text
),
s AS (

)
SELECT region, n AS months,
       ROUND(mp, 0) AS mean_monthly_profit,
       ROUND(mnp, 0) AS min_monthly,

       ROUND((mxp - mnp) / mp * 100, 1) AS range_pct_of_mean,

FROM s
ORDER BY cv_squared DESC;
```

### 上一批失败结果保留

上一批在相同13轮输入上，查询执行与结果归档中位数为普通7.870秒、使用FAD8.930秒；加上前台开销后的任务时间配对中位数增加1.158秒。新批次重新建立独立普通对照，不复用旧查询耗时。旧原始记录和[完整统计](statistics-async-million-before-cte-cost.json)保留。

本次同时调整索引准入与CTE改写；这是整个修复的对照结果，不是只改其中一个功能的消融实验。每轮实际执行SQL、对象来源和计划可直接核对。

### 控制条件与适用范围

- 每次全新数据库副本、进程和连接；相同预热、WAL、缓存与两个逻辑CPU；五对随机AB/BA串行执行，两组互不并发。普通组只处理SQL，不解码FAD或启动优化器。
- 背景进程只接收已到达的FAD；没有未来SQL、未来间隔或离线匹配结果。对象提交完成后才可用，原始输入和数据哈希不变。
- 64项测试通过，包括CTE作用域/同名遮蔽、聚合结果、索引筛选准入和后台未提交时查询继续执行；独立13条语义验证及正式130条源结果比对、65条直接对照均通过。
- 修复基于这条轨迹暴露的问题；正收益仅证明当前轨迹上的可行性，不能替代未见任务上的验证。10%准入门槛仍是启发式；已建而未用的索引、两张汇总表数量上限和舍入保护仍限制收益。
- 固定间隔仅复用数值，空闲跳过；不重现模型/其他工具的CPU、I/O竞争及长时间空闲对缓存和频率的影响。本次不计额外生成FAD的模型延时。
- 数据为原18,250行复制扩到百万行，新增运单号唯一，其他业务字段保留；分组基数未同比增大。数据库副本位于/tmp的tmpfs，属于内存文件系统上的SQLite实验，不是物理磁盘性能结果。
- 异步汇总表是副本中的任务级普通表，以便跨连接共享，任务末尾删除。所有后台进程正常关闭；浮点结果按绝对1e-7、相对1e-9核对，完整列名、行数、重复行、NULL和排序保留。

## 以下为旧串行成本诊断

**下方旧实验使用30轮来源，构建串行阻塞；只能说明串行执行时的成本，不能代表当前后台准备的查询延时。**
## DAComp-006：合成1,000,000行

**比较普通SQL执行与SQL＋FAD优化，所有FAD处理、估计扫描、建对象、改写和清理成本均计入；不调用Agent。**

按用户要求，每种方式5对独立实验，共15对、30次正式回放。每次均新副本、新进程、新连接、相同完整预热流程，随机AB/BA串行执行。SQL、FAD、对象数量上限、两次预测触发规则和优化预算公式保持不变。

### 总耗时与净收益

**扩大到100万行后，这三种方式的中位数仍没有净收益。**
总耗时为5次的中位数，比例为5个配对比例的中位数，不能用两个取整后的时间精确复算。5对属于初步观察，以下保留每一对，不给出看似精确的置信区间。

### 时间花在哪里

单位秒，均为各自5次的中位数。构建时间包含空间估计所需扫描；各项中位数不一定相加等于总耗时。

| 时间部分 | 索引：普通 → 优化 | 汇总表：普通 → 优化 | 组合：普通 → 优化 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| SQL及全部结果归档 | 17.091 → 18.308 | 17.119 → 15.232 | 17.149 → 14.487 |
| FAD解码、校验和列引用汇总 | 0.000 → 0.160 | 0.000 → 0.163 | 0.000 → 0.160 |
| 编译预检、匹配改写及浮点保护 | 0.000 → 0.070 | 0.000 → 0.129 | 0.000 → 0.199 |
| 决策、估计扫描、构建 | 0.000 → 3.815 | 0.000 → 2.983 | 0.000 → 6.964 |
| 对象清理 | 0.000 → 0.108 | 0.000 → 0.000 | 0.000 → 0.108 |
| 连接、目录/行数统计、日志及其他开销 | 0.004 → 0.081 | 0.004 → 0.081 | 0.004 → 0.081 |

这次校验和匹配基本不随行数增长，构建扫描则随数据一起变大。以下分别列出查询节省与构建成本，判断有没有回本：

- 仅索引：查询本身反而增加1.208秒，构建（含估计扫描）花3.813秒。
- 仅汇总表：查询合计省1.887秒，构建（含估计扫描）花2.979秒。
- 索引＋汇总表：查询合计省2.648秒，构建（含估计扫描）花6.959秒。

固定检查成本和构建成本要分开看。下表是优化组总耗时中的占比：

| 方式 | FAD校验＋改写检查：小库 → 百万行 | 构建（含估计）：小库 → 百万行 |
|---|---:|---:|
| 仅索引 | 43.1% → 1.0% | 10.2% → 16.9% |
| 仅汇总表 | 50.1% → 1.6% | 7.2% → 16.0% |
| 索引＋汇总表 | 54.7% → 1.6% | 13.3% → 31.6% |

仅汇总表模式仍保留那张没有华南过滤、未被后续使用的月度利润表；占用一个名额并产生真实构建成本。没有因提前看到结果而替换策略。索引也不是自动收益：某些查询用了索引但比直接扫描更慢，逐轮表保留这些负结果。

### 数据如何扩容、结果是否一致

- 原始18,250行完整复制54份，再无放回抽取14,500行；固定种子20260910。新增订单只修改运单号，其他业务字段整行保留。
- 生成后逐行回读核验1,000,000行。原始53条重复运单号未修复，新增运单号不冲突。华南371,782行，8种产品、277个目的地、原有日期范围不变。
- 原始SQL/FAD轨迹不变，仍为30次尝试、29次成功。Q10原有STDEV失败保留；每对均与百万行普通执行结果比较，不能拿小库答案做基准。
- 15对共450条查询对照全部通过；整数/字符串/NULL精确核对，浮点仍采用绝对1e-7、相对1e-9容差，ORDER BY逐行比较，其余保留重复行。未放宽正确性要求。
- 合成数据增加了行数，分组基数没有增长，可能有利于汇总表；不能推论真实业务类别增加时也有相同效果。新库沿用表结构，没有初始索引。
- 生成文件、输入准备、复制和完整预热放在计时外；两组都如此。主实验是预热条件，不声称操作系统冷缓存。

<a id="million-q12"></a>
#### Q12

<details><summary>原SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(profit), 0) AS avg_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit) - AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)), 0) AS std_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit) - AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/AVG(profit)*100, 1) AS cv_profit_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(revenue), 0) AS avg_revenue,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(revenue*revenue) - AVG(revenue)*AVG(revenue)), 0) AS std_revenue,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(revenue*revenue) - AVG(revenue)*AVG(revenue))/AVG(revenue)*100, 1) AS cv_revenue_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(cost), 0) AS avg_cost,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(cost*cost) - AVG(cost)*AVG(cost)), 0) AS std_cost,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(cost*cost) - AVG(cost)*AVG(cost))/AVG(cost)*100, 1) AS cv_cost_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(qty), 0) AS avg_qty,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(qty*qty) - AVG(qty)*AVG(qty)), 0) AS std_qty,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(qty*qty) - AVG(qty)*AVG(qty))/AVG(qty)*100, 1) AS cv_qty_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(orders), 0) AS avg_orders,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(orders*orders) - AVG(orders)*AVG(orders)), 0) AS std_orders,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(orders*orders) - AVG(orders)*AVG(orders))/AVG(orders)*100, 1) AS cv_orders_pct
FROM (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, 
    SUM(Profit) AS profit, 
    SUM("Total Logistics Revenue") AS revenue, 
    SUM("Total Logistics Cost") AS cost,
    SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty,
    COUNT(*) AS orders
  FROM sheet1 
  WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' 
  GROUP BY month
)
```

<a id="million-q13"></a>
#### Q13

<details><summary>原SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT "Consigned Product", 
  ROUND(AVG(profit),0) AS avg_monthly_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)),0) AS std_monthly_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/AVG(profit)*100,1) AS cv_pct,
  MIN(profit) AS min_m, MAX(profit) AS max_m,
  ROUND(MAX(profit)-MIN(profit),0) AS range_m,
  SUM(profit) AS total_profit,
  SUM(qty) AS total_qty
FROM (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, "Consigned Product" AS product, 
    SUM(Profit) AS profit, SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY month, product
)
GROUP BY product ORDER BY std_monthly_profit DESC
```

<details><summary>原SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT Destination,
  ROUND(AVG(profit),0) AS avg_monthly_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)),0) AS std_monthly_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/NULLIF(AVG(profit),0)*100,1) AS cv_pct,
  ROUND(MAX(profit)-MIN(profit),0) AS range_m,
  SUM(profit) AS total_profit
FROM (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, Destination, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY month, Destination
)
GROUP BY Destination ORDER BY std_monthly_profit DESC LIMIT 20
```

<a id="million-q27"></a>
#### Q27

<details><summary>原SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN province='Guangdong Province' THEN profit END) AS guangdong,
  SUM(CASE WHEN province='Guangxi' THEN profit END) AS guangxi,
  SUM(CASE WHEN province='Hainan Province' THEN profit END) AS hainan,
  SUM(CASE WHEN province='Henan Province' THEN profit END) AS henan,
  SUM(CASE WHEN province='Hubei Province' THEN profit END) AS hubei,
  SUM(CASE WHEN province='Hunan Province' THEN profit END) AS hunan
FROM (
  SELECT substr(Destination, 13, instr(substr(Destination, 13)||'-', '-')-1) AS province,
    strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY province, month
) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
```

<a id="million-q30"></a>
#### Q30

<details><summary>原SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT 'Freight' AS cost_type, ROUND(AVG(val),0) AS avg, ROUND(SQRT(AVG(val*val)-AVG(val)*AVG(val)),0) AS std, ROUND(SQRT(AVG(val*val)-AVG(val)*AVG(val))/AVG(val)*100,1) AS cv_pct FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM("Freight Cost") AS val FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY month)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Warehousing', ROUND(AVG(val),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(val*val)-AVG(val)*AVG(val)),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(val*val)-AVG(val)*AVG(val))/AVG(val)*100,1) FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM("Warehousing Cost") AS val FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY month)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Other Costs', ROUND(AVG(val),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(val*val)-AVG(val)*AVG(val)),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(val*val)-AVG(val)*AVG(val))/AVG(val)*100,1) FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM("Other Operating Costs") AS val FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY month)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Orders', ROUND(AVG(val),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(val*val)-AVG(val)*AVG(val)),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(val*val)-AVG(val)*AVG(val))/AVG(val)*100,1) FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS val FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY month)
```

下面保留原始18,250行实验，两个规模分开阅读。
## DAComp-006：原始18,250行

**本次实现没有获得数据库端净收益。三种方式都加快了一部分SQL，但全部优化成本计入后，整段轨迹耗时增加。**

输入为已保存的006轨迹：30次SQL尝试，29次成功；Q10原本调用SQLite不支持的STDEV，两组保留同一失败。这里没有调用Agent，不含模型生成FAD的延时。**对照组只接收SQL并正常执行，完全不接收或处理FAD，也不创建优化控制器。优化组接收SQL＋FAD，承担FAD处理和优化的全部成本。**

本报告已按用户纠正的对照重新实测。旧的“两组都处理FAD”结果已撤出主要结论；本次数字来自全新的120次回放，不是从旧耗时中扣减校验时间。

### 整个任务到底快了多少

每种方式各20对独立实验，共60对、120次回放。下表总耗时为20次的中位数；“增加比例”为每对相对变化的中位数。单位毫秒。

| 数据库处理方式 | 对照组总耗时 | 优化组总耗时 | 耗时增加比例 | 比对照快的实验 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 仅建索引 | 252.0 | 511.7 | 103.4% | 0/20 |
| 仅建汇总表 | 252.2 | 556.3 | 121.0% | 0/20 |
| 索引＋汇总表 | 251.9 | 638.6 | 153.5% | 0/20 |

配对净节省 = 同一对的对照耗时 − 优化耗时，负数表示变慢。95%区间采用固定种子的10,000次配对重采样，保留每对关联，不把120次当作互不相关的样本：

| 方式 | 配对净节省中位数 | 95%区间 | 最小～最大 | 加速倍数（小于1为变慢） |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 仅建索引 | -259.7 ms | [-260.7, -258.8] ms | [-268.9, -252.0] ms | 0.492× |
| 仅建汇总表 | -304.2 ms | [-305.4, -302.4] ms | [-310.1, -284.6] ms | 0.453× |
| 索引＋汇总表 | -386.5 ms | [-388.2, -385.4] ms | [-393.2, -378.8] ms | 0.394× |

### 时间花在哪里

以下按每种方式各自的20对结果计算中位数。各分段中位数不一定精确加成总耗时。SQL时间包含完整结果读取和逐行写入结果文件；“决策及构建”已经包含估计扫描、建对象和失败尝试，不要再次加上对象表中的构建时间。

| 时间部分（ms） | 索引：对照 → 优化 | 汇总表：对照 → 优化 | 组合：对照 → 优化 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| SQL执行与完整结果归档 | 248.9 → 222.1 | 249.3 → 222.0 | 248.9 → 184.5 |
| FAD解码、格式/目录校验及列引用汇总 | 0.0 → 154.8 | 0.0 → 156.9 | 0.0 → 156.4 |
| SQL编译检查、匹配改写及浮点保护 | 0.0 → 66.0 | 0.0 → 121.9 | 0.0 → 193.1 |
| 优化决策、估计扫描与对象构建 | 0.0 → 54.6 | 0.0 → 42.9 | 0.0 → 89.2 |
| 清理优化对象 | 0.0 → 2.0 | 0.0 → 0.1 | 0.0 → 2.2 |
| 连接初始化、必要日志与关闭（优化组另含空间检查） | 3.0 → 11.7 | 3.0 → 11.8 | 3.0 → 12.1 |

- 仅建索引：SQL本身合计省约 **26.8 ms**，但任务总耗时增加约 **259.7 ms**。
- 仅建汇总表：SQL本身合计省约 **27.2 ms**，但任务总耗时增加约 **304.2 ms**。
- 索引＋汇总表：SQL本身合计省约 **64.3 ms**，但任务总耗时增加约 **386.5 ms**。

这里最明显的限制是：原始数据很小，单条SQL通常只需几毫秒；本次Python原型逐轮做SQL解析、结构匹配及保守检查，成本超过省下的扫描时间。这个结果说明当前实现和策略在该规模不划算，不能据此声称FAD没有预测价值，也不能用单条查询加速代替任务净收益。

### 结果是否一致、实验是否独立

- 先用独立诊断副本验证，再开始正式计时；正式实验结束后再次逐条核对所有结果。60对全部通过，29条成功查询的列名、列顺序、行数、重复行和数值一致；Q10失败状态和错误也一致。
- 有ORDER BY时逐行比较，否则比较保留重复行的多重集合。浮点绝对容差1e-7、相对容差1e-9；没有放宽到容忍整数位变化。
- 每次新数据库副本、新进程、新任务连接，预热完整基础表后关闭预热连接，再开始计时。两组都如此。这是统一预热实验，不是操作系统冷缓存实验。
- 60对顺序及每对AB/BA顺序由固定种子随机生成，串行执行，计时进程固定到同一逻辑CPU。对象每次重新构建，优化时间不跨实验摊销。共享机器不声称独占。
- 对象只能在本轮SQL结束后由本轮已到达FAD触发，不能用于本轮SQL。控制器不读取未来SQL或离线命中分析；每轮日志保存查询前可用对象。
- 下载/复制/预热属于共同准备，计时外单列；优化所需统计扫描、建表/建索引、检查、归档与清理全部计时。没有异步工作或虚构的Agent思考空档。

**校准中的失败也保留了：** 初次索引运行在Q13、Q15将一个ROUND结果从40455变成40454。原因是索引改变浮点累加顺序。正式版本对当前SQL含ROUND和聚合、且基础表原先无索引的情况恢复全表读取；汇总表构建也保持该读取路径。这个保护没有按Q编号特判，成本和牺牲的索引机会都反映在正式结果里。Q10曾被SQL解析器重印函数名导致错误文本变化，现优化组先检查原SQL，原本失败的SQL保持原样执行；对照组直接执行原SQL，保留数据库原生错误。

### 哪些FAD建出了对象，后来谁用了

下表构建时间包含为估计空间所做的扫描。占用空间是独立诊断测得的已使用页增长（包含页管理开销），不是文件长度增长；两个索引合计使用1180 KiB，但复用了原库空闲页，主库文件没有变大。实际使用依据独立诊断运行的EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN；汇总表还必须在实际执行SQL中出现。正式运行逐轮改写、可用对象及结果均与诊断核对。

未使用的典型对象是“无过滤的月度利润汇总表”：Q1/Q2预测了该模式，但后续月度查询实际加了华南过滤，且常要求更多指标。首版不猜过滤范围、不补未预测指标，因此不能复用。仅汇总表模式下它占去一个名额，仍完整承担构建成本。其余候选因为没有再次出现、已有对象达到数量上限，或所需指标未被覆盖，没有继续构建；详细原因在逐轮日志中。

组合模式每轮也只建一个对象，因此前两次先建索引，随后建出的两个汇总表与“仅汇总表”模式不同。这是同一选择规则的结果，不是人为给组合模式另选后续查询。

<a id="q12"></a>
#### Q12

<details><summary>原SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(profit), 0) AS avg_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit) - AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)), 0) AS std_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit) - AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/AVG(profit)*100, 1) AS cv_profit_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(revenue), 0) AS avg_revenue,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(revenue*revenue) - AVG(revenue)*AVG(revenue)), 0) AS std_revenue,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(revenue*revenue) - AVG(revenue)*AVG(revenue))/AVG(revenue)*100, 1) AS cv_revenue_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(cost), 0) AS avg_cost,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(cost*cost) - AVG(cost)*AVG(cost)), 0) AS std_cost,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(cost*cost) - AVG(cost)*AVG(cost))/AVG(cost)*100, 1) AS cv_cost_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(qty), 0) AS avg_qty,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(qty*qty) - AVG(qty)*AVG(qty)), 0) AS std_qty,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(qty*qty) - AVG(qty)*AVG(qty))/AVG(qty)*100, 1) AS cv_qty_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(orders), 0) AS avg_orders,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(orders*orders) - AVG(orders)*AVG(orders)), 0) AS std_orders,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(orders*orders) - AVG(orders)*AVG(orders))/AVG(orders)*100, 1) AS cv_orders_pct
FROM (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, 
    SUM(Profit) AS profit, 
    SUM("Total Logistics Revenue") AS revenue, 
    SUM("Total Logistics Cost") AS cost,
    SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty,
    COUNT(*) AS orders
  FROM sheet1 
  WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' 
  GROUP BY month
)
```

<details><summary>原SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT "Consigned Product", 
  ROUND(AVG(profit),0) AS avg_monthly_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)),0) AS std_monthly_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/AVG(profit)*100,1) AS cv_pct,
  MIN(profit) AS min_m, MAX(profit) AS max_m,
  ROUND(MAX(profit)-MIN(profit),0) AS range_m,
  SUM(profit) AS total_profit,
  SUM(qty) AS total_qty
FROM (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, "Consigned Product" AS product, 
    SUM(Profit) AS profit, SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY month, product
)
GROUP BY product ORDER BY std_monthly_profit DESC
```

<details><summary>原SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT Destination,
  ROUND(AVG(profit),0) AS avg_monthly_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)),0) AS std_monthly_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/NULLIF(AVG(profit),0)*100,1) AS cv_pct,

)
```

```sql
SELECT product AS prod, 
  ROUND(AVG(profit),0) AS avg_monthly_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)),0) AS std_monthly_profit,
  ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/NULLIF(AVG(profit),0)*100,1) AS cv_pct,
  ROUND(MIN(profit),0) AS min_m, ROUND(MAX(profit),0) AS max_m,
  ROUND(MAX(profit)-MIN(profit),0) AS range_m,
  SUM(profit) AS total_profit, SUM(qty) AS total_qty
FROM (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, "Consigned Product" AS product, 
    SUM(Profit) AS profit, SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY month, product
)
GROUP BY product ORDER BY std_monthly_profit DESC
```

<a id="q27"></a>
#### Q27

<details><summary>原SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN province='Guangdong Province' THEN profit END) AS guangdong,
  SUM(CASE WHEN province='Guangxi' THEN profit END) AS guangxi,
  SUM(CASE WHEN province='Hainan Province' THEN profit END) AS hainan,
  SUM(CASE WHEN province='Henan Province' THEN profit END) AS henan,
  SUM(CASE WHEN province='Hubei Province' THEN profit END) AS hubei,
  SUM(CASE WHEN province='Hunan Province' THEN profit END) AS hunan
FROM (
  SELECT substr(Destination, 13, instr(substr(Destination, 13)||'-', '-')-1) AS province,
    strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY province, month
) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
```

<a id="q28"></a>
#### Q28

<details><summary>原SQL</summary>

```sql
SELECT 'Guangdong' AS prov, ROUND(AVG(profit),0) AS avg_p, ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)),0) AS std_p, ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/AVG(profit)*100,1) AS cv_pct FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China-Guangdong%' GROUP BY month)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Guangxi', ROUND(AVG(profit),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/AVG(profit)*100,1) FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China-Guangxi%' GROUP BY month)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Hainan', ROUND(AVG(profit),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/AVG(profit)*100,1) FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China-Hainan%' GROUP BY month)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Henan', ROUND(AVG(profit),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/AVG(profit)*100,1) FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China-Henan%' GROUP BY month)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Hubei', ROUND(AVG(profit),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/AVG(profit)*100,1) FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China-Hubei%' GROUP BY month)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Hunan', ROUND(AVG(profit),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(profit*profit)-AVG(profit)*AVG(profit))/AVG(profit)*100,1) FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China-Hunan%' GROUP BY month)
```

```sql
SELECT 'Freight' AS cost_type, ROUND(AVG(val),0) AS avg, ROUND(SQRT(AVG(val*val)-AVG(val)*AVG(val)),0) AS std, ROUND(SQRT(AVG(val*val)-AVG(val)*AVG(val))/AVG(val)*100,1) AS cv_pct FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM("Freight Cost") AS val FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY month)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Warehousing', ROUND(AVG(val),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(val*val)-AVG(val)*AVG(val)),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(val*val)-AVG(val)*AVG(val))/AVG(val)*100,1) FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM("Warehousing Cost") AS val FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY month)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Other Costs', ROUND(AVG(val),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(val*val)-AVG(val)*AVG(val)),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(val*val)-AVG(val)*AVG(val))/AVG(val)*100,1) FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM("Other Operating Costs") AS val FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY month)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Orders', ROUND(AVG(val),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(val*val)-AVG(val)*AVG(val)),0), ROUND(SQRT(AVG(val*val)-AVG(val)*AVG(val))/AVG(val)*100,1) FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS val FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY month)
```

| 方式 | 新占用页 | 主库文件增长＋临时库页数 | 进程峰值RSS：对照 → 优化 | CPU时间：对照 → 优化 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 仅建索引 | 1180 KiB | 0 KiB | 43.1 → 46.0 MiB | 250.7 → 508.7 ms |
| 仅建汇总表 | 20 KiB | 20 KiB | 43.1 → 44.3 MiB | 250.8 → 553.4 ms |
| 索引＋汇总表 | 1248 KiB | 68 KiB | 43.1 → 46.1 MiB | 250.6 → 635.2 ms |

原库自带687个空闲页，共2,813,952字节，索引复用它们，所以文件不增长并不表示索引不占空间。新占用页在独立副本重放动作测量，未混入正式计时；具体记录见space-diagnostic.json。当前预算监控主库文件增长与临时库页数，新占用的空闲页另列；本次实际使用也低于7,507,968字节上限。RSS为整个进程峰值，包含Python库和计时前预热。这些数据不是排序器临时文件的完整峰值。各次进程I/O（read_bytes/write_bytes及rchar/wchar）和准备时间保存在summary.json；完整环境、顺序、数据/代码哈希保存在manifest.json。

### 当前结论与后续范围

A—E的小型固定轨迹验证已经完成：预测可以促成真实复用，但当前Python实现与选择规则在18,250行上没有净收益。本小节保留原始规模结论；百万行扩容的独立结果已列在上方。本小节未运行实时Agent；上方异步实验另采集了完整来源会话。
